newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciampi sees Italy June inflation at 1.5 pct-ANSA.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi sees Italy June inflation at 1.5 pct-ANSA.

text.p: Italian inflation would show a fall to 1.9 percent year-on-year "in a few days" and consumer price inflation may stabilise at 1.5 percent at the end of June, the Italian news agency ANSA quoted Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi as saying on Saturday.
The statistics institute ISTAT is due on Monday (0700 GMT) to release official data for consumer price inflation in March.

Economists have forecast March inflation of 0.1 percent month-on-month and 2.2 percent year-on-year against 0.1 and 2.4 percent in February. Inflation in Italy has fallen steadily in the past year to its lowest levels since 1969.
ANSA said Ciampi made the forecasts to reporters at Noordwijk in the Netherlands, where European Union finance ministers met for talks on Europe's planned economic and monetary union.
ANSA quoted Ciampi as saying the government forecast for 1997 of average annual inflation of 2.5 percent remained reasonable.
